subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I am now getting best job opportunities after this internship.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before the term "**best job opportunities**."
 
• Superlative adjectives like "best" are typically preceded by the definite article "the."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**getting the best job opportunities**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I am now **getting** **the best job opportunities** after this internship."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
 
• **Part 3: "after this internship"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "I am now"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
